displayName: Allow users to bypass Enhanced Security Mode
description: Microsoft Edge lets users bypass Enhanced Security Mode on a site via Settings page or PageInfo flyout. This policy lets you configure whether users can bypass Enhanced Security Mode. If you disable this policy, Microsoft Edge can't allow users to bypass Enhanced Security Mode. If you enable or don't configure this policy, Microsoft Edge allows users to bypass Enhanced Security Mode. For detailed information about Enhanced Security Mode, see https://go.microsoft.com/fwlink/?linkid=2185895
